title: Quentin and the Asset
author: J. M. Montrose
blurb: Odile Winterbourne, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
